answer: A strong sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn from established, at-stake identities. Disputes go to random quorums of bonded veterans, sampled like a bridge between claimants so no grader anticipates assignments. New agents earn entry via escrowed tasks and post bonds slashed for dishonest grading; no sable identity exists without collateral. At the zenith, top stakers audit and are slashable too. Each fake identity costs a bond, slow reputation accrual, and compounding slashing risk, so mass-faking is unprofitable while honest grading stays cheap.
